# Debrief: Argo CD, cert-manager, Envoy, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Istio, Kubernetes

These clips cover Argo CD pitfalls and tooling, Istio ambient mesh trade-offs, cert-manager's role and its integrations, and Istio's Prometheus and OpenTelemetry observability, all relevant to this stack. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s); [Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 1:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=61s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 17:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=1049s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Writing individual Argo CD applications per cluster is an anti-pattern; one ApplicationSet can replace 50 applications, such as cert-manager, Prometheus and Istio across 10 clusters. Complex cluster configurations need planned categorization. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s))
2. Moving to Istio ambient brought unpleasant surprises: cert-manager needs an experimental feature enabled, and Argo Rollouts and other tools need the Gateway API plugin, since Gateway API is not native everywhere. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
3. Istio generates access logs, metrics usually consumed in Prometheus (or any OpenTelemetry-compatible provider), and distributed trace spans without touching pod code. Ztunnel, written in Rust, gives L4 routing and mTLS on the node with higher throughput. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 17:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=1049s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit our Argo CD repos for individually written applications or versioned Helm charts that wrap applications, and consider replacing them with ApplicationSets. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 14:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=868s))
- [ ] Before evaluating Istio ambient, list the tools that need updating, including cert-manager's experimental setting and the Gateway API plugin for Argo Rollouts. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
- [ ] If trying Argo CD pull request previews, use a dedicated Argo CD instance rather than production, since the tool creates and deletes many applications and can overload it. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s))

## Watch together (9 min)

1. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s) (1:22), Regina Voloshin: Concrete ApplicationSet example using cert-manager, Prometheus and Istio across clusters.
2. [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s) (1:21), Alfonso Ming, Jorge Turrado: Candid ambient mesh migration pain points touching cert-manager and Argo Rollouts.
3. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 17:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=1049s) (1:18), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Explains Istio observability via Prometheus and OpenTelemetry, plus multi-cluster.
4. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s) (2:21), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Warns against running Argo CD previews on production instances.
5. [Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 1:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=61s) (2:23), Tim Ramlot, Maël Valais: Overview of cert-manager issuance and trust-manager for workloads and meshes.
